Salvador boosts your crimson furnace, and he also builds up furnace quite a bit. His enlightens mostly improve this, like his E3 makes you passively regen furnace. Because of this your furnace can heal more, tho I usually use the furnace he builds up to make a fat shield.

Leigh is a great healer that heals based on missing HP , meaning the more near death you are the more she heals so a Leigh with hp recovery can almost heal you back to half health from near death if she's built for recovery. Note that because of this, you'll usually get the Scars debuff when playing in Arc 2 rules because of the heals she does. She also has a 3-cost that gives you shield the next turn based on the damage you receive in the current turn. She is kinda lackluster early, but is great once you get her OE (at least from my personal experience in DTide. Might be a skill issue on my part) .

Clementine is also a great healer when roused. Her 2-cost heals you and applies str down, which plays 2 times if she's roused and if it's the first card Clementine plays in a turn.

Not a healer, but Ghelot's flails heal based on missing HP.

When you have Miryam image, Miryam also heals quite a bit because every turn she gives you a sacrifice card, which you can use to regen % of your missing HP.

Other healing include the lost HP healing and the % current HP shielding of Birth of a Soul. It's one of the, IMHO, greatest defensive wheels
